_comment: Reconstructed minimal safety corpus. The original Tessera corpus referenced project-local git SHAs (git_show entries) and was never committed to this repo, leaving tier-router-validate.ts with nothing to load. Every entry here is an embedded fixture so the validator is hermetic and deterministic (heuristic mode only).

entries.label_rationale: ESCALATE keyword is a full-tier anchor (rule 2)
engine/ path token + A2 (new architectural pattern) are full-tier anchors (rule 2)
ambiguous directive must fall back to full — the rule-5 uncertainty escape hatch
Coordinator wave plan must never route implementer-only (rule 1)
methodology / REINFORCEMENT consolidation routes audit, never implementer-only (rule 4)
mechanical doc-only change with one ALLOWED path routes implementer-only (rule 3) — unconstrained sanity case
